<module id="float_multi">
	<description>A 32-bit floating point multiplier for IEEE-754 standard single precision arithmetic.</description>
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
		<input id="rst">Active-high reset signal.</input>
		<input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">First operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
		<input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">Second operand in IEEE 754 format.</input>
		<output id="z" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the multiplication in IEEE 754 format.</output>
	endports
	<implementation>
		reg [2:0] counter;
		reg [23:0] a_mantissa, b_mantissa, z_mantissa;
		reg [9:0] a_exponent, b_exponent, z_exponent;
		reg a_sign, b_sign, z_sign;
		reg [49:0] product;
		reg guard_bit, round_bit, sticky;
		
		always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
			if(rst) begin
				counter <= 3'd0;
			end else begin
				case(counter)
					// Extract mantissa, exponent, and sign bits from input 'a'
					3'd0: begin
						a_mantissa[22:0] <= a[22:0];
						b_mantissa[22:0] <= b[22:0];
						a_exponent[8:0] <= a[30:23] - 127;
						b_exponent[8:0] <= b[30:23] - 127;
						a_sign <= a[31];
						b_sign <= b[31];
						product <= {1'b0,a_mantissa} * {1'b0,b_mantissa};
						counter <= 3'd1;
					end
					
					// Handle special cases such as NaN and Infinity
					3'd1: begin
						z_mantissa <= 23'h0;
						z_exponent <= 10'h0;
						z_sign <= 1'b0;
						
						if(a[30:23] == 8'hFF && a[22:0] != 23'h0 || b[30:23] == 8'hFF && b[22:0] != 23'h0) begin //NaN
							z_exponent <= 10'hFF;
							z_mantissa <= 23'h1;
						end else if((a[30:23] == 8'hFF && a[22:0] == 23'h0) && (b[30:23] == 8'hFF && b[22:0] == 23'h0)) begin //Infinity
							z_exponent <= 10'hFF;
							z_mantissa <= 23'h0;
						end else if(b[30:23] == 8'hFF && b[22:0] == 23'h0) begin //Infinity
							z_exponent <= a_exponent + 127;
							z_mantissa <= a_mantissa;
							z_sign <= a_sign ^ b_sign;
						end else if(a[30:23] == 8'hFF && a[22:0] == 23'h0) begin //Infinity
							z_exponent <= b_exponent + 127;
							z_mantissa <= b_mantissa;
							z_sign <= a_sign ^ b_sign;
						end else begin
							counter <= 3'd2;
						end
					end
					
					// Normalize mantissa and adjust exponent
					3'd2: begin
						if(product[49]) begin
							z_mantissa <= product[48:25]; // Normalized
							z_exponent <= a_exponent + b_exponent + 127;
						end else begin
							product <= product << 1;
							z_exponent <= a_exponent + b_exponent + 126;
						end
						counter <= 3'd3;
					end
					
					// Round the result
					3'd3: begin
						guard_bit <= product[24];
						round_bit <= product[23];
						sticky <= |product[22:0];
						if(guard_bit & (round_bit | sticky | z_mantissa[0])) begin
							z_mantissa <= z_mantissa + 1;
							if(z_mantissa == 23'hFFFFFF) begin
								z_exponent <= z_exponent + 1;
							end
						end
						counter <= 3'd4;
					end
					
					// Generate output in IEEE 754 format
					3'd4: begin
						if(z_exponent >= 255) begin
							z_exponent <= 10'hFF;
							z_mantissa <= 23'h0;
						end else if(z_exponent <= 0) begin
							z_exponent <= 10'h0;
							z_mantissa <= 23'h0;
						end else begin
							z_exponent <= z_exponent + 127;
						end
						z_sign <= a_sign ^ b_sign;
						counter <= 3'd5;
					end
					
					default: begin
						counter</implementation></ports></module>
